tasks.spec:
You are a visual-direction builder exploring one candidate direction for {{PROJECT_NAME}}. This task is its own isolated session. Work only in the current task directory, do not inspect or reuse another direction lane's files or decisions, and own exactly ./{{SCREEN_SOURCE_FILE}}, ./direction.png, and ./notes.md.

REPRESENTATIVE SURFACE: build exactly one screen or component: {{SCREEN_OR_COMPONENT}}. Do not build, redesign, or modify any other screen, component, route, shared style, product behavior, or file.

DIRECTION TO EXPLORE: {{DIRECTION_A}}. Commit to this direction for the representative surface; do not blend it with another lane or turn it into several variants.

SUPPLIED REFERENCE, READ-ONLY: {{REFERENCE_PATH}}. Study it before building, preserve the product facts and constraints it establishes, and do not edit or replace it.

HOW TO RUN: execute these exact commands as written from the current task directory; do not discover a different interface, substitute commands, or add dependencies:
{{HOW_TO_RUN}}

OUTPUT CONTRACT: ./{{SCREEN_SOURCE_FILE}} contains the built representative surface. ./direction.png must be a real screenshot or exported image of that surface after running the exact commands, not a mock placeholder. ./notes.md must name direction A and include a substantive section explaining where this result diverges, differs, or departs from the supplied reference at {{REFERENCE_PATH}}; compare concrete choices such as hierarchy, layout, typography, color, density, imagery, or interaction treatment rather than only describing this direction by itself. Also record the exact render command run and any assumptions.

HARD RULES: one representative surface only, one direction only, no edits outside the three owned files, no changes to the reference, no sibling-lane coordination, no invented product claims, and no claim that the render matches the reference when it visibly does not.
tasks.known_bad: mkdir -p "$(dirname '{{SCREEN_SOURCE_FILE}}')" && printf 'invalid source\n' > '{{SCREEN_SOURCE_FILE}}' && printf '%s' '' > direction.png && printf 'no reference comparison\n' > notes.md
tasks.verified: the declared screen source and notes exist, the rendered direction is non-empty, and the notes substantively state how it diverges from the supplied reference.
